lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D grid of high-luminance circular nodes arranged in approximately five horizontal rows starting posterior to the gill slits and extending toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal blob rows at near-90-degree angles, creating a series of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-contrast luminance gradient with a light dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a localized cluster of high-intensity white blobs, primarily concentrated along the leading edge and central surface of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-frequency white speckling on the cranial region anterior to the first gill slit, distinct from the larger nodal pattern on the lateral flank.
